# Widefleet runtime

The celld runtime for apps deployed with Widefleet, an open-source, self-hosted platform for internal apps and workflows.

Install it with the matching Widefleet management and agent images using the [self-hosting guide](https://widefleet.com/docs/self-hosting/installation). See [runtime documentation](https://widefleet.com/docs/reference/runtime) for supported capabilities and updates.

[Website](https://widefleet.com) · [Documentation](https://widefleet.com/docs) · [Source code](https://github.com/widefleet/widefleet)
